All bidders are required to submit the same as a part of their technical bid. This policy is detailed in the bidding documents. 9. Bidder shall ensure to sub mit an acceptable Bid Security/EMD, mandatorily submit all documents in support of Qualification Require ments and all the Bid Forms duly filled, signed, completed and submit the same a s a part of their technical bid. 10.
